result:
The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's instruction at step 22. WebSurfer had correctly found the right article, but it was scrolling one page at a time and had reached only about 37% of the page. The Orchestrator recognized the loop, but its replacement instruction asked WebSurfer to search the article for keywords like "full paper" or "observations." WebSurfer has no find-in-page capability, so it ignored the request and scrolled again. The paper link was never reached, and the run ended without the correct award number. The instruction was not executable, so the search for the paper stalled from that point on.

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> WebSurfer)
STEP: 22
